description: Delete ALL historical balance entries for a single account. This is irreversible and affects the Net Worth views. To remove a single month, use delete_balance_history_entry instead.

account_id.description: Id of the account whose entire balance history should be deleted. For deleted accounts, pass the deleted_account_id.

account_type.description: Type of account the balance history belongs to. Use manual for manually-managed accounts, plaid for synced bank accounts, crypto_manual for manually-managed crypto, and deleted for accounts that no longer exist but still have history. Synced crypto uses the dedicated crypto_synced tools instead.

name: delete_account_balance_history
